info.name: Sandar API (staging)
info.description: Automation practice against Sandar staging. Import the Sandar Staging environment, then run in order. The API only accepts the x-sandar-client header and an Origin equal to baseUrl. Login sets an HttpOnly cookie, so keep the cookie jar on.

item.name: Negative: self-harm text is not stored

request.description: On staging no email is sent. Read the code with SQL: SELECT code FROM staging_emails WHERE template='OPS_CODE' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; then set opsCode in the environment.

item.name: 06 Ops after the code (set opsCode first)
